text: Common courtesy goes a long way. Saying good morning, good evening, and being polite regardless of how trying the situation is.

People tend to communicate at arms length, although with an increased level of familiarity, this distance can decrease. In business and more formal situations this distance may be considerably larger. Touching of hands during conversations is quite common between friends and members of the opposite sex. This does not tend to be so between business colleagues.
Direct eye contact is acceptable, but too much can be considered staring, which is rude. It's best to strike a balance.
It is normal to be late for meetings with friends and other social situations. Buses and other service do not tend to run on time. Being on time in professional situations is expected.
Women used to be the homemakers, but that has changed and they are now on a more equal footing with men. On average, they tend to work much harder than men.
The legal drinking age is actually 21, but it is not enforced. Illegal drugs, theft and brutal crimes are heavily enforced, with hard time in jail.
For Men - Dress pants, collared shirt, clean shoes. For Women -Same, including skirts/dresses.

It's best to address people by their proper title followed by their surname. Mr., Mrs., Ms., Dr., etc. It's polite to wait to call someone by their first name until invited to do so. There is no specific ritual surrounding the giving of business cards although it is advisable to treat the card with respect.
It's best to be honest about the price, but some bargaining is expected now and then. Remain calm throughout the process. Decisions may take awhile to be reached.
Gifts are not expected during initial business meetings.

Most schools begin the first week of September and end in July. Vacations range from 2 weeks to 2 months in the summer. Appropriate dress at the university level is usually j eans, dress pants, shirt or blouse. Shorts tend to be unacceptable, as well as very revealing clothing. Grades are given on a 1 – 5 scale, with 1 being the best grade. Various forms of teaching are used including: lecture, group work, experiential, etc.

Most students socialize by going to parties, discos, concerts etc. Drinking is usually acceptable but it is considered rude to be excessively drunk in public. As far as dating goes, b oth men and women tend to ask each other out.
